behaviorChanges: The npm registry copy leads with the product and the real install (`Tautline is a Python CLI. Install it with pipx`) instead of self-describing as a namespace pointer; the name-reservation fact stays in plain words -- the package reserves the name and contains no code. The payload and its shape guards are unchanged -- there is still no npm wrapper by decision. The published npm page updates at the next release-tail.
Dev toolchain: mypy 2.3.0 (from Dependabot #384, adopted through the version-bump contract); CI type-checking behavior is otherwise unchanged (0 issues at adoption).

Repo process: Dependabot raises PRs against `experimental` instead of the promotion-only `main`; four pre-0.9.16 implementation-review ledgers carry backfilled finding titles (derived from their own recorded summaries; no reclassification); and the public boundary scan AND the release export's dirty-state gate both ignore `.claude/` local agent-session state, whose untracked worktree checkouts of historical branches made scan verdicts and export refusals depend on which sessions ran on the machine.
rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.0 restores the namespace-pointer npm copy in `registry-package` output; nothing else to roll back -- no on-disk state, command surface, or adapter content moves in either direction.
